# Bundled EasyList

Unmodified EasyList by **The EasyList authors (https://easylist.to/)**, downloaded from https://easylist.to/easylist/easylist.txt. The exact source version, upstream commit, retrieval time and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in [provenance.json](provenance.json).

The filter data is distributed under [CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported](LICENSE-CC-BY-SA-3.0.txt), one of the licenses offered by the [authors](https://easylist.to/pages/licence.html). The complete original subscription is retained, including its notices; the native integration uses its network rules and exceptions only. No filter downloads, refresh scheduler, cosmetic hiding, scriptlets or subscription editing are implemented.

The separately bundled Ghostery engine and its dependencies retain their own licenses in `.runtime/web-adblock/licenses.txt`, generated from the installed packages by the build. The pinned engine version is in `package.json` and exact dependency resolutions are in `package-lock.json`.
